_doc: Pervežimų grafikas — schedule data for the DEMO build only: tools/build.py renders it into the three Global Sections GS-Išvykimai (ticker), GS-Artimiausi (next date per direction) and GS-Grafikas Airija / Ispanija (timetable rows) via the {{grafikas:*}} placeholders. In production each of those Global Sections is hand-edited once a month with native elements (Scrolling Text, Horizontal List Item) — no shortcode, no ACF repeater, no client-side recompute. Dates are ISO (year assigned from the 2026-09-23 crawl — client to confirm). render_today = the date the static build treats as 'today' (keeps the build deterministic; dates are written in full, never 'po N d.'). Outbound rows dial the LT line; inbound rows dial the destination-country line.
note: Tikslų išvykimo laiką ir paėmimo vietą suderinsime telefonu.
